items.title: Epic: AI to convert UE5 projects to UE6; Fortnite's 20,000+ Blueprints ported to ~3M lines of Verse by AI; UE 5.9 gets UE6 AI tooling (Python, MCP)
items.excerpt: Epic's Marcus Wassmer says Blueprints will no longer coexist with Scene Graph in UE6 because AI is expected to make UE5-to-UE6 conversion practical or automatic; Epic used AI to port Fortnite Battle Royale's 20,000+ Blueprints into a ~3M-line Verse prototype, and brings expanded Python scripting and MCP improvements to UE 5.9. Epic says much of UE 5.9 was built with AI agents.
items.rationale: Primary-source Epic post that tells every Unreal team how its Blueprint projects will reach UE6 (AI conversion, Fortnite port as proof, Python/MCP in 5.9). This is the most actionable item in the pool.

items.title: Unite Tokyo 2026 Keynote recap: Unity Neural (neural texture compression), official coding-agent plug-ins for Claude/Codex/Antigravity/Grok, AI Asset Library search
items.excerpt: Unity showed Unity Neural, AI-powered rendering tools whose Neural Texture Compression cut the Atrio demo's texture memory by ~30% (experimental in Unity 6.7 LTS, full in Unity 7), official plug-ins for Claude, Codex, Google Antigravity and Grok, an agent-driven prototype demo, and an Asset Library plug-in that finds assets by text prompt.
items.rationale: Primary-source Unity announcement of new tools: Neural Texture Compression with a version roadmap, more official agent plug-ins, and prompt-based asset search. Pairs with the Epic card as this week's engine-side news.

items.title: How HoYoverse Is Keeping Petit Planet's AI NPCs From Harassing Players
items.excerpt: Petit Planet's AI cafe NPC Nalo remembers past conversations; HoYoverse says AI NPCs have preset moral values, refuse toxic or manipulative prompts, escalate to warnings and human intervention, and the AI features are optional via an in-game toggle.
items.rationale: Concrete design pattern for shipping LLM NPCs: preset values, refusal, escalation to humans, and an opt-out toggle. Any designer building AI characters can reuse it.

items.title: 'Now, more than ever, it's about design': John Romero loves that games are easier to make but warns 'most are trash'
items.excerpt: John Romero says game-making is easier than ever but most new releases are 'trash', many AI-generated or auto-generated with game-making kits, so design now matters more than ever.
items.rationale: A veteran's take on the AI-slop flood that argues design is what sets a game apart. Kept as the single card on this theme over the GamesIndustry.biz Warshaw/E.T. piece.

items.title: "Making 3D Modeling Easy for Everyone": Tripo AI Expands Reach to B2C
items.excerpt: At G-Star 2026, 3D model generation platform Tripo AI, already widely used by game developers, outlined its push to expand from B2B game-studio use toward everyday consumer creators.
items.rationale: A 3D-asset generation tool that studios already use announces a move into consumer creators at G-Star. It is a different story from the 11-12 Tripothon hackathon card and brings in a fifth outlet.

https://www.unrealengine.com/news/an-upd.new_action: Epic's official 11-20 post announces AI-driven UE5-to-UE6 project conversion, reveals the AI port of Fortnite BR's 20,000+ Blueprints into ~3M lines of Verse, and ships UE6 AI tooling (expanded Python, MCP) in UE 5.9. The 11-05 card only reported Sweeney's keynote plan to drop Blueprints; the 11-20 YouTube Unreal MCP tutorial (history_match) was a how-to video.

https://unity.com/blog/unite-tokyo-2026-.new_action: Unite Tokyo 2026 announces Unity Neural / Neural Texture Compression (experimental in 6.7 LTS, full in Unity 7), new official Claude/Codex/Grok plug-ins beyond the Antigravity one covered 11-03, and an AI Asset Library prompt-search plug-in.
